H01.description: Passes `config or {}` to _update_class_schema because the typed-dict config may now be None.

H02.description: For a stdlib dataclass without __pydantic_config__, head pushes an empty config instead of None, so the parent's config is not inherited during JSON schema generation, unlike core schema generation.

H03.description: Passes `config or {}` to _update_class_schema because the dataclass config may now be None.

H04.description: Updates the return annotation to ConfigDict | None and adds a comment for the typed-dict config fix.

H05.description: _get_typed_dict_config returns {} for a typed dict with no config, so the pushed empty config overrides the parent's config instead of inheriting it, as core schema generation does.

I01.description: Class config (incl. json_schema_mode_override) is pushed inside dataclass/typed-dict schema generation, after the definitions cache lookup in generate_inner, so nested schemas can be cached under the wrong mode.
